why: The first frozen trust page. A real security page names five standards in five different shapes - a heading, a sentence, a list item - and the extractor must find each one and hand the model the sentence that says whether they hold it. SOC 2 appears both alone and as SOC 2 Type II, which is the case the longest-spelling-first rule exists for.
